positions.name: RehearsalMandateOperationalized
positions.frame: what turns a principle about unrehearsed capability into an actual operational commitment — cadence and ownership?
positions.why: src-1 states the identity-level principle (rehearsal is possession) as a directive establishing the practice; src-2 and src-3 immediately operationalize that principle into a concrete cadence and a named owner. The conviction pass marks src-1 as 'principle' while src-2/src-3 register as 'decision' — a gradient from creed to settled operational commitment, held together as one read: the principle only counts once it is scheduled and owned. The tension between aphoristic urgency (src-1) and flat matter-of-fact labeling (src-2, src-3) is part of the read, not resolved by it.
